Reproduced on 2026-07-28 at r = 0.885 against the community's published map for this recipe on PHerc0139 20250108000000-w025, with their CT, their mesh, their runner and this checkpoint -- whose sha256 and size are byte-identical to scrollprize/ink_canonical_2um. It took two corrections: routing the lane to this recipe's own runner, and --flip-normals on the render. One window of one segment, so this is a reproduction and not a validation of the method.

This recipe ships its own runner and the registry named the generic one. They are not interchangeable: the generic runner normalises clip(0,200)/200 and resamples the depth axis, and this recipe divides by 255 with no clip and takes consecutive layers. Measured 2026-07-28 against the community's published map for this very recipe on PHerc0139 20250108000000-w025, on ground where our render matches theirs at r=0.98: the generic runner's map correlates r=0.079. ink-canonical-2um-screening@1.0.0 stays on record with the wrong adapter because its hash is in receipts; @1.1.0 is the lane to route.
